compositions.threat: One Born in Chaos melee pursuer pressures players who stop to mine.
compositions.counterplay: Keep a clear retreat lane and use corners to break pursuit.

compositions.threat: Two melee pursuers make a narrow dead end costly to hold.
compositions.counterplay: Retreat through a wider junction and avoid letting both close together.

compositions.threat: A quicker armored melee fighter contests space alongside a pursuer.
compositions.counterplay: Focus one target, kite around a junction, and avoid being cornered.

compositions.threat: Two fast melee attackers can close from different angles.
compositions.counterplay: Use the room perimeter, keep moving, and regroup before re-engaging.

compositions.threat: An armored, faster attacker and two pursuers divide attention in a large chamber.
compositions.counterplay: Coordinate target focus, keep the exit visible, and use distance to reset the fight.

compositions.threat: Three fast armored attackers create a mobile swarm rather than a stationary damage race.
compositions.counterplay: Fight from open space, call focus targets, and peel attackers off teammates.
